title: Citigroup CEO Fraser on Clarity Act: 'We would like to see a good bill go through,' as stablecoin reward issues simmer
message_html: Citigroup CEO Fraser on Clarity Act: 'We would like to see a good bill go through,' as stablecoin reward issues simmer ...
snippet: Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser says she would like to see a crypto bill passed into law, even as she and others continue to fight for changes.
